purpose: General Solo progression, compared within this eight-partner shortlist.

picks.reason: Confusion starts with homing shots and fits its stronger Special attack.
picks.watchFor: Favor Special damage cards; Physical buffs strengthen a different attack side.

picks.reason: Shadow Ball starts with piercing projectiles and fits its stronger Special attack.
picks.watchFor: Keep space around you: 97 HP and 60 physical defense leave less room for contact hits.

picks.reason: Water Gun provides a piercing start, backed by 120 Special defense.
picks.watchFor: Special bulk does not cover its lower physical defense of 65.

picks.reason: Sludge applies poison from a Special projectile start.
picks.watchFor: Physical defense is the weaker side at 66; keep a route out of crowds.

picks.reason: A 120-HP option with Razor Leaf and Giga Drain in its move pool.
picks.watchFor: Speed 91 needs deliberate positioning. Vine Whip starts on its weaker Physical side.

picks.reason: High HP and a strong Physical attack factor suit a Physical-focused plan.
picks.watchFor: Tackle starts at short range; Special defense is the weaker side.

picks.reason: A fast Physical option with Karate Chop and Ghost moves in its pool.
picks.watchFor: Karate Chop needs close positioning. Keep an exit from the crowd.

picks.reason: Thunder Shock starts fast and pierces; Discharge and Thunderbolt are available later.
picks.watchFor: Lower HP, defenses and Special attack make it a lower-priority choice in this shortlist.
